resource: Travel confirmation timeout of an NPC conversation
allocation_impact: A pending travel confirmation holds one conversation state for at most 30 s; anything else or the timeout cancels it. No retained state after close.
boundary_tests: max=30: a yes at 30 s still confirms
max+1: a yes after 30 s cancels
notes: NPC-0 §4. Worker-set; enforced by NPC-TALK-1. Registered by OTV2-20261005-npc-wire-1 (NPC-WIRE-1).
